title: Senior IT Security Engineer
announcement: About the Position: We are looking for a Security Engineer to support, automate and continuously improve the secure configuration of our enterprise assets. In this role, you will be the central point of contact for hardening standards, access controls, and the protection of our IT infrastructure against common attack vectors. You will work closely with various teams and locations to implement security requirements in a practical and sustainable way. Your Responsibilities: Configuration Standards: Develop, maintain, and harden the security configuration standards for end-user devices, servers, network components, and software (on-prem/SAAS)  Identity and Access Management: Manage and oversee centralized Identity and Access Management throughout the account and employee lifecycles, including account provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning during onboarding, role changes, and onboarding Compliance Monitoring & Audits: Conduct recurring control reviews to verify that approved security processes, technical specifications, configurations, account management practices, and access controls are implemented and operating effectively across the organization Security Automation: Automate configuration validation and remediation, and integrate security-baseline checks into infrastructure provisioning and deployment workflows Collaboration: Work closely with various teams and locations to implement and oversee the above security measures in practice Your Profile: 5+ years of expertise in IT security with relevant exposure to configuration and hardening 2+ years of practical experience implementing security frameworks and standards, such as CIS Controls and Benchmarks, NIST guidance, and ISO/IEC 27001 Solid knowledge and practical experience of hardening operating systems (Windows/Linux/Mac) and network components 3+ years of experience with Identity & Access Management concepts (roles, permissions, recertification) Page 2 of 3 Familiarity with configuration management or compliance tools  Analytical and strategic thinking Independent working style and initiative Strong communication skills Fluent English and German would be beneficial Beneficial skills: Scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) Knowledge with endpoint protection platforms (EDR/XDR) Security Monitoring, Investigation, and Threat Detection Experience integrating automated configuration, hardening, and compliance checks into infrastructure provisioning and deployment pipelines Any Relevant Certifications What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment About us Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.  This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
